changelog_v110_items: Custom cover and title support (manual overrides).
Larger default window size for optimal layout.
changelog_v100_items: Official rename to Machete PS5 Backup Manager.
changelog_v020_items: Incorporation of native deletion prevention system (Native Dialog).
UI restructuring with Cyberpunk styling and dark mode.
Native support for 11 languages with dynamic switching.
changelog_v010_items: Proof of concept. Asynchronous file reading.
Basic initial connection with SerialStation API.
changelog_v120_items: Added file/folder transfer support via Drag & Drop and Click.
Added transfer progress UI (Speed and ETA calculation).
Fixed grid padding for perfect cover cropping.
changelog_v200_items: Nueva interfaz Cyberpunk (Tarjetas 3D, Consola Hacker, Disco Holográfico).
Motor I/O asíncrono impulsado por Tokio.
Cálculo de hashes Blake3 Anti Bit-Rot.
Cálculo dinámico del tamaño total del directorio.
changelog_v123_items: Corregido error de '0 GB' en el peso de carpetas.
Añadido cálculo total de GB en la barra superior.
update_none: You're running the latest version. No updates available.
update_error: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
changelog_v210_items: 3D Anti-Gravity visual effect with floating levitation and dynamic floor shadows.
Official soundtrack playback for each game (native Rust ATRAC9 snd0.at9 decoder).
Signature harmonic crystal selection chime inspired by the PlayStation 5 UI.
Quick Mute/Audio toggle in the top bar with persistent local storage.
Detailed Game Inspector Modal with 4K covers and direct file manager access.
Multi-selection with keyboard shortcuts and floating batch action bar.
Interactive Storage Analyzer with dynamic treemap and large backup rankings.
changelog_v202_items: In-app auto-updater: checks for new versions from GitHub Releases.
Download & install updates directly from the app with progress bar.
Dynamic version display in About section (no more hardcoded versions).
Full updater UI localized in 12 languages.
settings_visual_effects_desc: Enables 3D anti-gravity physics, elevation shadows, and cyberpunk neon glows.
settings_audio_desc: Plays PS5 interface acoustics and original snd0.at9 game soundtracks.
